title: Jeremy Sochan Reveals Possible Rift With Spurs Coach Mitch Johnson After Exit - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Jeremy Sochan and Mitch Johnson (Photo By Imagn Images) The San Antonio Spurs have enjoyed a strong start to the season. Despite this, the franchise granted forward Jeremy Sochan permission to explore trade possibilities . Eventually, Sochan finalized a buyout agreement with San Antonio and made his move to the New York Knicks.
While Sochan openly expressed excitement about beginning a new chapter in New York , he also appeared to deliver a subtle shot at his former situation. In an interview with The Athletic, Sochan offered an honest assessment of his tenure with the Spurs while hinting at a possible disconnect with Spurs coach Mitch Johnson.
‚Äú No real opportunity in my opinion. It is what it is. It‚Äôs a deep team. Maybe I didn‚Äôt see eye-to-eye with coach. I‚Äôm just blessed to be somewhere to grow, ‚Äù Sochan said.
This season, Sochan appeared in just 28 games without a single start, averaging 12.8 minutes per contest. His limited role coincided with a dip in production, as he recorded 4.1 points, 2.6 rebounds, and 1.0 assists per game.
The 2025-26 season marked the lowest statistical output of his three-year stint in San Antonio. Prior to this season, Sochan had never averaged fewer than 11 points while playing more than 25 minutes per game.
Jeremy Sochan Embraces Fresh Opportunity in New York Jeremy Sochan (Image Credits: Imagn) Sochan is now determined to reestablish his value on the court. In a recent interview, Sochan shared his mindset entering this next chapter.
‚ÄúIt‚Äôs just seizing whatever opportunity I get. And I think one of the reasons why I picked New York is it‚Äôs a very deep roster, a lot of really talented players, and I think it‚Äôs a pretty cool opportunity just to watch and to grow from that too ,‚Äù he said.
Sochan began his NBA journey as the ninth overall selection in the 2022 NBA Draft out of Baylor. Now, for the first time in his professional career, he is stepping into a completely new environment with a new hope.
